question:
Select the word that best completes the given sentence. Determine the collocation through the sentence.

My mother told me we should ____________ precautions to avoid getting sick during flu season.
solution:
The correct answer is '**take**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The collocation "take precautions" is the correct phrase in this context. The verb "take" is commonly used with "precautions" to mean to adopt or implement measures to avoid harm or danger.
 
• "Show precautions" is not a common collocation in English.
 
• "Hold" and "see" are also incorrect in this context, as they do not naturally pair with "precautions" in this manner.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *"My mother told me we should take__ precautions to avoid getting sick during flu season."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Show (दिखाना)**: does not form a common collocation with "precautions."
 
• **Hold (रखना)**: also does not pair naturally with "precautions" in the context of this sentence.
 
• **See (देखना)**: similarly, "see" is not used with "precautions" in standard English usage.
